Weekly balance excluding construction: #v £[Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_phi_budget').GetValue|0]#!
Crew required for a fully staffed fleet: #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_phi_needed_crew').GetValue|0]#!
Unemployed workforce: #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_phi_unemployment').GetValue|%1]#!
Workforce below the starvation threshold: #v [Country.MakeScope.Var('nesnd_phi_starving').GetValue|%1]#!

Each requirement fills one segment: a nonnegative balance excluding construction, no [concept_default] or [concept_bankruptcy], and any agreed subsidy actually being paid; at least #v 35 battalions#! in the standing army; at least #v 40 ships#! under the garrison agreement or #v 20 ships#! under the naval division, with #v 75%#! of crews and at least #v 80%#! naval maintenance fulfillment; unemployment at most #v 12%#! and no more than #v 15%#! of the workforce below the starvation threshold. Updated monthly.

zh: 南洋联省的海船将染料运往江南，田主和商行从这条航路上收取地租、货款与利息。沿岸的村社也被卷入了这场繁荣：农户把收成交给园主，流民向承包人借钱，下一年的劳动便早早写进了债契。\n\n[Country.GetName]需要伐木、搬运和经营港务的人，也需要留下能够养活一家人的稻田。让新雇工领到工钱、让佃户留住收成，将决定联省的腹地能否成为一个有买卖、有积蓄的地方。
en: Dye shipments connect the southern plantations to the imperial market. Rent, advances and debt bind many village households to that trade. New paid work and viable smallholdings will determine whether the interior can sustain its own customers and savings.

The expedition would also remove old western officers from the mainland. Overseas garrisons and commerce still compete for the same ships and revenue.

proposed.zh: 丰臣氏借明吴之力平定战国，又与郑氏共争朝鲜。两家的旧盟维持了海东秩序，也使九州驻军与日本诸侯结下了绵延数代的利害。如今南朝大局已定，朝廷开始议论东征：将西军旧部调往海东，在丰臣之外扶植天皇与德川的政权，使三家各领其土，九州、四国则归吴朝直辖。远洋驻军与海上商路，也将随这次分封重新安排。
proposed.en: The Toyotomi unified Japan with Ming and Wu assistance and fought beside the Zheng in Korea. Their old alliance bound the garrisons in Kyushu to the interests of Japan’s lords. zh: 秦军退守伊犁以后，陈秦皇族仍时常东顾玉门，军士和武勋门阀却已不敢轻言东征。帝国需要恢复生产和税收，军府也需要新的兵员与军饷。安国派主张先改旧法，使农工商各得其利；统治派则认为，没有强兵护持，朝廷的法令终究到不了地方。
en: Since the Qin armies withdrew to Ili, the Chen imperial house has continued to look east toward the Jade Gate. Its soldiers and military nobility are less eager to march again. The military faction insists that imperial decrees will carry little weight in the provinces without an army to enforce them.
